description: This file contains the implementation of an Ethernet driver for the SMSC911x/SMSC9220 hardware, including register access functions, initialization routines, interrupt handling, and transmission/reception logic.

methods.name: smsc_mac_regread
methods.description: Reads a MAC register from the SMSC device.

methods.name: smsc_mac_regwrite
methods.description: Writes a value to a MAC register on the SMSC device.

methods.name: smsc_phy_regread
methods.description: Reads a PHY register via MDIO interface.

methods.name: smsc_phy_regwrite
methods.description: Writes a value to a PHY register via MDIO interface.

methods.name: smsc_read_mac_address
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address from the device registers.

methods.name: smsc_check_id
methods.description: Checks the device ID to verify hardware presence.

methods.name: smsc_soft_reset
methods.description: Performs a soft reset of the SMSC device.

methods.name: smsc_set_txfifo
methods.description: Configures the transmit FIFO size.

methods.name: smsc_init_irqs
methods.description: Initializes device interrupts.

methods.name: smsc_check_phy
methods.description: Checks PHY presence via MDIO registers.

methods.name: smsc_reset_phy
methods.description: Resets the PHY.

methods.name: smsc_advertise_caps
methods.description: Advertises link capabilities via PHY registers.

methods.name: smsc_establish_link
methods.description: Establishes network link by configuring PHY.

methods.name: smsc_enable_xmit
methods.description: Enables transmission in the device.

methods.name: smsc_enable_mac_xmit
methods.description: Enables MAC layer transmission.

methods.name: smsc_enable_mac_recv
methods.description: Enables MAC layer reception.

methods.name: smsc_init
methods.description: Initializes the SMSC device hardware.

methods.name: eth_smsc911x_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns the Ethernet hardware capabilities.

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Returns Ethernet statistics.

methods.name: eth_initialize
methods.description: Initializes Ethernet interface and MAC address.

methods.name: smsc_write_tx_fifo
methods.description: Writes data to the device's transmit FIFO.

methods.name: eth_tx
methods.description: Transmits a network packet.

methods.name: eth_smsc911x_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for handling device interrupts.

methods.name: eth_init
methods.description: Platform-specific Ethernet device initialization.
